text:
Anya (Product): Quick sync — proposing an "audit-enrichment" spec so every audit event carries tenant_id, data_class (sensitive|non-sensitive), retention_hint, evidence_id (sha256), and optional kms_key_id when BYOK is used. Need alignment on: schema shape, backward compatibility, cost attribution labels, and launch criteria for SOC2 evidence. Thoughts?

Matt R (Eng): +1. Can retention_hint be an enum? cold/standard/ephemeral. Also how do we tag events created before rollout? backfill plan?

Devon (Infra): Backfill is painful. Prefer avoiding mass reprocessing. We can add a `proto_enriched` flag and run an async enricher to patch indexes over 48h. For cost attribution, add `billing_tenant` label used by downstream billing pipeline.

Samira (Security): Evidence_id must be stable and collision-resistant. Use sha256 over canonicalized payload + metadata, optionally salted with kms_key_id when BYOK present. Legal-hold must always override retention_hint.

Anya (Product): Draft launch CRITERIA: 1) Schema v1 published & validation in ingest; 2) Console shows per-tenant retention summary; 3) Export API returns encrypted evidence bundle with proof for BYOK tenants; 4) SOC2 evidence runbook + ops playbook signed off by Security.

Devon (Infra): Ops playbook question: how should exports handle BYOK-encrypted logs? Suggest we store kms_key_id and a `kms_grant_handle` placeholder. Export job will orchestrate a short-lived grant for decryption at export time; we do NOT store plaintext or keys. Need security review.

Matt R (Eng): Proposed sample event (schema v1):
```json
{"event_ts":"2024-04-06T18:12:00Z","tenant_id":"tenant_42","event_type":"model.generate","evidence_id":"sha256:3f7a...","retention_hint":"standard","data_class":"sensitive","kms_key_id":"projects/acct/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/abc123","billing_tenant":"tenant_42","proto_enriched":true}
```

Samira (Security): Add `legal_hold_id` nullable. Require KMS/HSM attestation proof metadata on export requests for BYOK tenants (timestamped). Also log attestations in audit trail.

Anya (Product): Launch checklist items: schema migration doc, ingest validation, console UI for retention tiers, export flow with BYOK attestation, acceptance tests + SOC2 evidence checklist. Need owners for each bullet.

Devon (Infra): I can own enrichment pipeline + backfill plan.

Matt R (Eng): I'll own schema validation + REST API changes.

Samira (Security): Security will own SOC2 evidence runbook, attestation integration, and export threat model.

Anya (Product): Can we get an RFC by EOD Fri? I'll draft owners & acceptance criteria. ops-bot, please create RFC stub and assign reviewers. :pray:

ops-bot: RFC created: https://docs.internal/reports/audit-enrichment-rfc (created by Anya) :white_check_mark:

Matt R (Eng): +1. Also need a cost model: retention tiers mapped to $/GB/mo so sales can set expectations. Devon, can you rough-estimate infra delta?

Devon (Infra): Estimates will be in the RFC: rough +2–4% storage overhead for enrichment fields, +0.5% CPU for indexing, and negligible network change. Will refine once schema is final.

Anya (Product): Great. I'll assemble owners, acceptance criteria and post RFC updates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
